activities.description:
Verify that there are no gaps in any point of the system allowing air to bypass the filters (torch-light check).
• No breaking points of gaskets at flanged connections, particularly at corners.

activities.section_title: FILTER HOUSE INSTALLATION (ref. TPI sect.7.6)
activities.description:
Redundant sealing application.
• To seal off external gasket joints with a caulk profile on the outside to create a redundant approach in sealing the clean airside.
• Caulk all open external joints with Sikaflex 221 or Dow Corning 832. Apply with fingertip between the mating surfaces.

activities.section_title: FILTER HOUSE INSTALLATION (ref. TPI sect.7.6)
activities.description:
Verify correct installation of filters elements (High Efficiency Static Systems):
• Verify the neoprene gasket seal installation all around the frame surface of the pre-filters and high efficiency filter bags
• Verify the neoprene gasket seals have the correct contact on the support structure once the pre filter and high efficiency filter bags are installed
• Check if the neoprene gasket has not lost its typical mechanical properties of compression and sealing.
• Inspect all filter bags for damage. Replace damaged bags if needed
• Make sure that everything downstream the filters is clean.

activities.description:
Redundant sealing application.
• To seal off external gasket joints with a caulk profile on the outside to create a redundant approach in sealing the clean airside.

activities.section_title: FILTER HOUSE INSTALLATION (ref. TPI sect.7.6)
activities.description:
Verify correct installation of filters elements (High Efficiency Static Systems):
• Verify the neoprene gasket seal installation all around the frame surface of the pre-filters and high efficiency filter bags
• Verify the neoprene gasket seals have the correct contact on the support structure once the pre filter and high efficiency filter bags are installed
• Check if the neoprene gasket has not lost its typical mechanical properties of compression and sealing.
• Inspect all filter bags for damage. Replace damaged bags if needed
• Make sure that everything downstream the filters is clean.
